## Shaggy Demodand (CR 15)

**XP** 51,200  
 CE Medium outsider (chaotic, demodand, evil, extraplanar)  
 **Init** +7; **Senses** darkvision 120 ft.; Perception +34  

**Defense**

 **AC** 29, touch 13, flat-footed 26 (+3 Dex, +16 natural)  
 **hp** 225 (15d10+75)  
 **Fort** +14, **Ref** +10, **Will** +13  
 **DR** 15/good and magic; **Immune** acid, poison, mind-affecting effects; **Resist** cold 10, fire 10; **SR** 26  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 40 ft., fly 50 ft. (average)  
 **Melee** 2 claws +25 (1d6+9), bite +24 (2d6+9) or morningstar +24/+19/+14 (1d8+9), bite +24 (2d6+9)  
 **Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 15th)  

  At will—detect good, detect magic, detect thoughts (DC 17), fear (DC 19), gaseous form, invisibility (self only), magic circle against good, see invisibility, tongues  
 3/day—cloudkill (DC 20), dispel magic, fog cloud, ray of enfeeblement, stinking cloud (DC 18)  
 1/day—chaos hammer (DC 19), mass charm monster (DC 23), summon (level 6, 1d6 tarry demodands or 1d4 slime demodands 60%; or 1d2 shaggy demodands 30%)  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 28, **Dex** 16, **Con** 21, **Int** 18, **Wis** 18, **Cha** 20  
 **Base Atk** +15; **CMB** +24; **CMD** 37  
 **Feats** Alertness, Awesome Blow, Cleave, Great Cleave, Improved Bull Rush, Improved Initiative, Lightning Reflexes, [Weapon Focus (claw)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Weapon Focus (claw).*  
 **Skills** Acrobatics +14, Bluff +23, Diplomacy +23, Fly +13, Intimidate +23, Knowledge (arcana) +19, Knowledge (planes) +22, Perception +34, Sense Motive +6, Spellcraft +19, Stealth +21, Survival +21; **Racial Modifiers** +8 Perception  
 **Languages** Abyssal, Common, Ignan, Infernal, Terran  
 **Gear** morningstar  

**Ecology**

**Environment** any (Tarterus)  
 **Organization** solitary or troupe (2–5)  
 **Treasure** standard
